description.short_caption: Erythematous, scaly plaque with central clearing on the thigh.
description.detailed_description: This clinical photograph shows a large, annular lesion on the thigh. The lesion has a raised, erythematous border with scaling and central clearing, consistent with a ring-like appearance. The surrounding skin appears normal. The findings are suggestive of a dermatophyte infection, such as tinea corporis.

description.short_caption: Ulcerative lesion with surrounding erythema on the left thigh.
description.detailed_description: The image shows a clinical photograph of the left thigh. A central ulcerative lesion with a necrotic base and surrounding erythema is visible. Below the main lesion, there are smaller, erythematous papules arranged in a linear distribution, suggestive of lymphatic spread. The surrounding skin appears hyperpigmented, and there is no visible discharge from the lesions.
visible_findings: central ulcerative lesion with necrotic base
linear arrangement of smaller erythematous papules

description.short_caption: Facial lesions with nodules and scarring.
description.detailed_description: This clinical photograph shows the central face, including the nose and adjacent areas. There are multiple nodular lesions, some with overlying crusting, and areas of scarring. The lesions appear erythematous and are distributed across the nasal bridge, cheeks, and perioral region. The image is de-identified with black bars obscuring the eyes.

description.short_caption: Multiple dark maculopapular lesions on the palm and forearm.
description.detailed_description: This clinical photograph shows the palm of a hand and part of the forearm. Multiple dark, maculopapular lesions are visible, distributed across the palm and extending onto the forearm. The lesions vary slightly in size and are scattered irregularly. The background skin appears otherwise normal, with no visible erythema or scaling.
visible_findings: lesions on the palm and forearm

description.short_caption: Hyperpigmented macules on the soles of both feet.
description.detailed_description: This image shows the soles of both feet with multiple irregularly shaped hyperpigmented macules distributed across the plantar surfaces. The lesions vary in size and are more prominent on the medial and lateral aspects of the soles. The skin appears otherwise intact without visible ulceration or scaling. The background skin tone is uniform aside from the lesions.
